name: Ameriprint Apparel
old_description: Custom Screen Printing for Schools, Teams & Corporate Apparel
about:
Ameriprint Apparel has operated from Sun Prairie, Wisconsin since 1985. The shop at 1708 Sunfield Street serves the Madison metro area and runs Monday through Friday, 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. No founder names or ownership structure are publicly disclosed.

The company provides custom decoration services including screen printing for vibrant, durable bulk orders; embroidery for uniforms and promotional items; direct-to-film (DTF) and digital printing for full-color, on-demand designs on cotton and cotton-blend fabrics; and laser engraving on drinkware, awards, leather, and acrylic. It also sources promotional products such as tote bags, drinkware, pens, and headwear, and offers inventory storage and fulfillment for client webstores. All production occurs in-house at the Sun Prairie facility.

Customers range from schools and sports teams to corporate buyers, event organizers, and non-profit groups. Recent orders highlighted in reviews include team apparel for a Lithuanian dance festival, shirts for an American Legion post, fraternity t-shirts, and family reunion tops. The business also handles trade-show giveaways, employee onboarding kits, and holiday corporate gifts.

Ameriprint emphasizes its in-house graphics team and an online design tool that lets customers create or refine artwork. The company also promotes inventory storage and fulfillment as a way to streamline recurring orders, and notes that it can accommodate small orders alongside large runs.
